n1.speaker: character_a
n1.text: Oh, hello there. Can I help you with something?

n2.speaker: character_a
n2.text: The desk? Go ahead and take a look at it yourself.

n1.speaker: character_a
n1.text: Still thinking about that key? I already told you what I know.

n2.speaker: character_a
n2.text: Go on, the hallway's open now. See for yourself.

n1.speaker: character_a
n1.text: Wait — where did you find that key?!

n2.speaker: character_a
n2.text: ...Fine. It opens something down the hallway. You should go take a look.

n1.speaker: character_a
n1.text: Hm. I don't think that has anything to do with me.

n1.speaker: character_a
n1.text: You're holding onto something interesting there. Let me know if you find anything else.

n1.speaker: character_a
n1.text: Oh, you went and looked around the hallway? What did you think?

n2.speaker: character_a
n2.text: Nothing much to say about it, honestly.

n1.speaker: character_a
n1.text: Yes, I know Character B. We don't talk much.
